rules.check: An error in a queued run fails that execution only. Steps before the error keep their work (commit per step); the runs for the other records go on. When all runs have finished, the progress dialog asks whether to open the failed executions.
rules.message: %1 of %2 executions ended with an error. Do you want to open them?

notes: Requires the AutoFlow Supplier Foundation app, which depends on AutoFlow and AutoFlow Core. See docs/apps/SupplierFoundation.md.

Queued, unlike the other Supplier Foundation triggers: the page action creates one execution with a Job Queue entry per record and published flow, commits, and follows them in a progress dialog ('n of m done' + latest log message; gives up waiting after 5 minutes, the runs continue in the background).
Each run is an ordinary background run: commit per step, no timeout, Sleep allowed, a failure does not affect the other records' runs. Runs may finish in any order.
No configuration: write "configuration": {}. A timeoutSec left over from an earlier version is ignored.
Publish: no trigger-specific checks and no Job Queue entry at publish; entries are created when the action is used.
The page action is shown only while at least one flow is published on the trigger.
Outputs marked 'only when …' are not set when the condition fails; a {{trigger_<name>}} token for them then stays in the text verbatim.
Write the price with Set supplier price (action 5564014); Item Vendor no longer has a supplier price field.
Also started for one item by the step Start price and availability update (action 5564015), with Source = Item and without a progress dialog.
